property_summary: After any successful Put, the caller's recorded balance must be at least the amount just deposited (credits the full msg.value); the mutant credits only 1 wei, so any deposit larger than 1 wei leaves Acc(actor).balance < amount, breaking the rule.
change_summary: Replace `acc.balance += msg.value;` with `acc.balance += 1;` so the credited amount no longer equals the deposited value.
